title: Fixed Slotted Case and Hooked Pocket Tape
description: One newly authored complete static pocket tape-measure exterior. A whole compact enclosed shell has a true narrow front outlet. One continuous thick transverse-curved strip exits that opening in a fixed straight extended pose and meets one complete downturned end hook with a bottom foot. Two entire chamfered side covers, a fixed top thumb lock and an actual open offset belt clip complete the pocket housing. Two seated small heads are visual fasteners only. No exposed reel, desktop cradle, cutter ledge or cutting teeth are imported. One prop, zero scenes, three opaque materials. The strip is blank: no graduations, calibrated length, retraction, spring, measurement precision, hand fit or safety claim.
